89|def _seen(session_id: str) -> dict:
90|    key = session_id or "default"

93|        if entry is None:
94|            entry = {
95|                "spans": [], "span_chars": 0, "lines": {}, "raw": set(), "turns": {}

110|def note_turn(text: str, digest: str, session_id: str = "", turn_id: str = "") -> None:
111|    """Record a stored block's turn membership (mask clock)."""
112|    if not turn_id:
113|        return
114|    try:
115|        with _SEEN_LOCK:
116|            turns = _seen(session_id)["turns"]
117|            bucket = turns.get(turn_id)
118|            if bucket is None:
119|                bucket = {"hashes": [], "masked": False}
120|                turns[turn_id] = bucket
121|            if digest not in bucket["hashes"]:
122|                bucket["hashes"].append(digest)
123|    except Exception:

127|def expire_old_turns(
128|    session_id: str = "", keep_turns: int = _MASK_KEEP_TURNS
129|) -> int:
130|    """Drop fold-index entries (spans + lines) older than keep_turns turns."""
131|    try:
132|        with _SEEN_LOCK:
133|            seen = _seen(session_id)
134|            turns = seen.get("turns", {})
135|            ids = list(turns.keys())
136|            # File bodies stay relevant far longer than 2 tool steps: a loop of
137|            # read -> search -> terminal -> read must still recognise the file.
138|            file_keep = max(keep_turns * 4, _FILE_KEEP_TURNS)
139|            stale_file_hashes: set[str] = set()
140|            if len(ids) > file_keep:
141|                for tid in ids[: len(ids) - file_keep]:
142|                    stale_file_hashes.update(turns.get(tid, {}).get("hashes", []))
143|            if len(ids) <= keep_turns:
144|                return 0
145|            old_ids = ids[: len(ids) - keep_turns]
146|            doomed: set[str] = set()
147|            for tid in old_ids:
148|                doomed.update(turns.get(tid, {}).get("hashes", []))
149|                del turns[tid]
150|            if not doomed:
151|                return len(old_ids)
152|            kept_spans = []
153|            removed_chars = 0
154|            for span_hash, span_text in seen["spans"]:
155|                if span_hash in doomed:
156|                    removed_chars += len(span_text)
157|                else:
158|                    kept_spans.append((span_hash, span_text))
159|            seen["spans"] = kept_spans
160|            seen["span_chars"] = max(0, seen["span_chars"] - removed_chars)
161|            for line, owner in list(seen["lines"].items()):
162|                if owner in doomed:
163|                    del seen["lines"][line]
164|            # A cached file body whose turn expired must not be served later as
165|            # "identical to prior read in active context" -- the agent can no
166|            # longer see that body in its context window.
167|            for fmeta in seen.get("files", {}).values():
168|                if isinstance(fmeta, dict) and fmeta.get("digest") in stale_file_hashes:
169|                    fmeta["expired"] = True
170|            return len(old_ids)
171|    except Exception:
172|        return 0

206|def hygiene(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
207|    """Trailing-ws strip + blank-run collapse. Returns (text, saved)."""
208|    new = text
209|    if text.endswith((" ", "\t")) or " \n" in text or "\t\n" in text:
210|        new = _WS_TRAIL_RE.sub("", new)
211|    if "\n\n\n" in new:

230|def fold_spans(
231|    text: str,
232|    session_id: str = "",
233|    *,
234|    min_lines: int = _MIN_SPAN_LINES,
235|    min_chars: int = _MIN_SPAN_CHARS,
236|    owner: str | None = None,
237|    deadline: Any | None = None,
238|) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str]], int]:
239|    """Replace verbatim runs seen in earlier tool results with pointers."""
240|    seen = _seen(session_id)
241|    corpus = seen["spans"]
242|    lines = text.split("\n")
243|    if not corpus:
244|        return text, [], 0
245|    by_first: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
246|    for idx, (h, span) in enumerate(corpus):
247|        fl = span.split("\n", 1)[0]
248|        by_first.setdefault(fl, []).append(idx)
249|    line_owner = seen["lines"]
250|    out: list[str] = []
251|    folded_chars = 0
252|    i = 0
253|    n = len(lines)
254|    new_spans: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
255|    while i < n:
256|        if deadline is not None and (i & 255) == 0:
257|            deadline.check()
258|        line = lines[i]
259|        if (
260|            line_owner.get(line) is not None
261|            and len(line) >= _MIN_LINE_CHARS
262|            and not line.startswith("[tt:")
263|            and not line.startswith(_KEEP_PREFIX)
264|            and not is_exempt(line)
265|            and not is_important(line)
266|        ):
267|            ptr = seen_line(owner or line_owner[line])
268|            out.append(ptr)
269|            folded_chars += len(line) - len(ptr)
270|            i += 1
271|            continue
272|        best: tuple[int, int, str] | None = None
273|        for idx in by_first.get(lines[i], ()):
274|            h, span = corpus[idx]
275|            slines = span.split("\n")
276|            m = 0
277|            while i + m < n and m < len(slines) and lines[i + m] == slines[m]:
278|                m += 1
279|            if m >= min_lines:
280|                seg = "\n".join(lines[i:i + m])
281|                if len(seg) >= min_chars and (best is None or m > best[0]):
282|                    best = (m, idx, h)
283|        if best:
284|            m, _, _h = best
285|            seg = "\n".join(lines[i:i + m])
286|            ptr = seen_lines(m, owner or _h)
287|            out.append(ptr)
288|            folded_chars += len(seg) - len(ptr)
289|            i += m
290|        else:
291|            folded_line, extra = _fold_inner(lines[i], line_owner, owner)
292|            out.append(folded_line)
293|            folded_chars += extra
294|            i += 1
295|    if folded_chars == 0 and out:
296|        corpus_long = [ln for ln in line_owner if len(ln.split()) >= _SHINGLE_MIN_WORDS]
297|        if corpus_long:
298|            out, sh_saved = _fold_shingles(out, corpus_long, owner, deadline)
299|            folded_chars += sh_saved
300|    return "\n".join(out), new_spans, folded_chars

303|def _fold_intra_repeats(text: str, deadline: Any | None = None) -> tuple[str, int]:
304|    """Fold adjacent duplicate line runs inside one first-seen document."""
305|    lines = text.split("\n")
306|    if len(lines) < 4:
307|        return text, 0
308|    out: list[str] = []
309|    saved = 0
310|    i = 0
311|    n = len(lines)
312|    while i < n:
313|        if deadline is not None and (i & 511) == 0:
314|            deadline.check()
315|        line = lines[i]
316|        key = line.strip()
317|        if (
318|            not key
319|            or len(key) < _MIN_LINE_CHARS
320|            or line.startswith("[tt:")
321|            or line.startswith(_KEEP_PREFIX)
322|        ):
323|            out.append(line)
324|            i += 1
325|            continue
326|        j = i + 1
327|        while j < n and lines[j].strip() == key:
328|            j += 1
329|        run = j - i
330|        if run >= 3:
331|            out.append(line)
332|            marker = f"[repeated {run - 1}x]"
333|            out.append(marker)
334|            saved += sum(len(lines[k]) for k in range(i + 1, j)) - len(marker)
335|        else:
336|            out.extend(lines[i:j])
337|        i = j
338|    if not saved:
339|        return text, 0
340|    return "\n".join(out), saved

343|def _intra_template_key(line: str) -> str:
344|    norm = line.strip()
345|    if len(norm) < 20:
346|        return ""
347|    # Distinct port/config values must not collapse into one template key.
348|    if _VALUE_LINE_RE.search(line or ""):
349|        return ""
350|    key = _SLOT_RE.sub("{}", norm)
351|    if len(key) < 20:
352|        return ""
353|    if "{}" not in key:
354|        return ""
355|    return key

358|def _fold_intra_templates(
359|    text: str, owner: str | None = None, deadline: Any | None = None
360|) -> tuple[str, int]:
361|    lines = text.split("\n")
362|    groups: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
363|    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
364|        if deadline is not None and (idx & 511) == 0:
365|            deadline.check()
366|        if (
367|            not line.strip()
368|            or line.startswith("[tt:")
369|            or line.startswith(_KEEP_PREFIX)
370|            or is_important(line)
371|        ):
372|            continue
373|        key = _intra_template_key(line)
374|        if key:
375|            groups.setdefault(key, []).append(idx)
376|    big = {k: v for k, v in groups.items() if len(v) >= 3}
377|    if not big:
378|        return text, 0
379|    first_of = {}
380|    for key, members in big.items():
381|        first_of[members[0]] = (key, len(members))
382|    in_big = set()
383|    for members in big.values():
384|        in_big.update(members[1:])
385|    out: list[str] = []
386|    saved = 0
387|    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
388|        if idx in in_big:
389|            saved += len(line)
390|            continue
391|        out.append(line)
392|        if idx in first_of:
393|            _, count = first_of[idx]
394|            marker = template_head(count - 1, owner or "")
395|            out.append(marker)
396|            saved -= len(marker)
397|    if saved <= 0:
398|        return text, 0
399|    return "\n".join(out), saved

407|def _fold_headtail(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
408|    """HEAD_TAIL stub for large non-repetitive docs."""
409|    if len(text) < _HT_MIN_CHARS or "[tt:" in text[:2000]:
410|        return text, 0
411|    lines = text.split("\n")
412|    if len(lines) <= _HT_HEAD_LINES + _HT_TAIL_LINES + 10:
413|        return text, 0
414|    head = lines[:_HT_HEAD_LINES]
415|    tail = lines[-_HT_TAIL_LINES:]
416|    omitted = len(lines) - len(head) - len(tail)
417|    stub = f"[... {omitted} lines in CCR ...]"
418|    new_text = "\n".join(head + [stub] + tail)
419|    saved = len(text) - len(new_text)
420|    if saved <= 0:
421|        return text, 0
422|    return new_text, saved

425|def _shingles(line: str) -> frozenset:
426|    words = line.strip().split()
427|    if len(words) < 4:
428|        return frozenset()
429|    return frozenset(tuple(words[i:i + 3]) for i in range(len(words) - 2))

432|def _jaccard(a: frozenset, b: frozenset) -> float:
433|    if not a or not b:
434|        return 0.0
435|    inter = len(a & b)
436|    if not inter:
437|        return 0.0
438|    return inter / len(a | b)

445|def _fold_shingles(
446|    lines: list[str],
447|    corpus_lines: list[str],
448|    owner: str | None,
449|    deadline: Any | None = None,
450|) -> tuple[list[str], int]:
451|    """Fold near-duplicate lines (Jaccard>=0.8) against prior corpus lines."""
452|    if not corpus_lines:
453|        return lines, 0
454|    prints: list[dict] = []
455|    for cl in corpus_lines:
456|        if len(cl.split()) >= _SHINGLE_MIN_WORDS and not cl.startswith("[tt:"):
457|            prints.append((cl, _shingles(cl)))
458|    if not prints:
459|        return lines, 0
460|    min_len = len(shingle_head(1, "0" * 12))
461|    out: list[str] = []
462|    saved = 0
463|    for li, line in enumerate(lines):
464|        if deadline is not None and (li & 255) == 0:
465|            deadline.check()
466|        if (
467|            len(line) <= min_len
468|            or line.startswith("[tt:")
469|            or line.startswith(_KEEP_PREFIX)
470|            or is_exempt(line)
471|            or is_important(line)
472|        ):
473|            out.append(line)
474|            continue
475|        fp = _shingles(line)
476|        hit = False
477|        for cl, cfp in prints:
478|            if cl == line:
479|                continue
480|            if _jaccard(fp, cfp) >= _SHINGLE_MIN_JACCARD:
481|                out.append(shingle_head(1, owner or ""))
482|                saved += max(0, len(line) - len(out[-1]))
483|                hit = True
484|                break
485|        if not hit:
486|            out.append(line)
487|    return out, saved

490|def _fold_inner(
491|    line: str, line_owner: dict[str, str], owner: str | None = None
492|) -> tuple[str, int]:
493|    """Fold indexed inner lines inside one JSON envelope line."""
494|    if len(line) < 500 or line.lstrip()[:1] not in "{[":
495|        return line, 0
496|    try:
497|        data = fast_json_loads(line)
498|    except Exception:
499|        return line, 0
500|    saved = 0
501|
502|    def _walk(o: object) -> object:
503|        nonlocal saved
504|        if isinstance(o, dict):
505|            return {k: _walk(v) for k, v in o.items()}
506|        if isinstance(o, list):
507|            return [_walk(v) for v in o]
508|        if isinstance(o, str) and "\n" in o:
509|            parts = o.split("\n")
510|            kept = 0
511|            for idx, ln in enumerate(parts):
512|                if (
513|                    line_owner.get(ln) is not None
514|                    and len(ln) >= _MIN_LINE_CHARS
515|                    and not ln.startswith("[tt:")
516|                ):
517|                    ptr = seen_line(owner or line_owner[ln])
518|                    saved += len(ln) - len(ptr)
519|                    parts[idx] = ptr
520|                    kept += 1
521|            if kept:
522|                return "\n".join(parts)
523|        return o
524|
525|    try:
526|        new_data = _walk(data)
527|        if not saved:
528|            return line, 0
529|        return _json.dumps(new_data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False), saved
530|    except Exception:
531|        return line, 0

534|def _index_json_inners(seen: dict, text: str, key: str) -> None:
535|    """Index lines inside JSON string fields."""
536|    import json as _json
537|
538|    def _walk(o: object) -> None:
539|        if isinstance(o, dict):
540|            for v in o.values():
541|                _walk(v)
542|        elif isinstance(o, list):
543|            for v in o:
544|                _walk(v)
545|        elif isinstance(o, str):
546|            for ln in o.split("\n"):
547|                _index_long_line(seen, ln, key)
548|
549|    if text.lstrip()[:1] in "{[":
550|        try:
551|            _walk(fast_json_loads(text))
552|            return
553|        except Exception:
554|            pass
555|        try:
556|            obj, _ = _json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(text.strip())
557|            _walk(obj)
558|            return
559|        except Exception:
560|            pass
561|    for ln in text.split("\n"):
562|        s = ln.strip()
563|        if len(s) > 200 and s[:1] in "{[":
564|            try:
565|                _walk(fast_json_loads(s))
566|            except Exception:

570|def remember(text: str, session_id: str = "", owner: str | None = None) -> str:
571|    """Index content for future folding within bounded per-session budgets."""
572|    if not isinstance(text, str):
573|        return owner or ""
574|    key = owner or hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:12]
575|    if len(text) > _MAX_SPAN_CHARS:
576|        return key
577|    with _SEEN_LOCK:
578|        seen = _seen(session_id)
579|        corpus = seen["spans"]
580|        if any(eh == key for eh, _ in corpus):
581|            return key
582|        while corpus and (
583|            len(corpus) >= _MAX_SPANS
584|            or seen["span_chars"] + len(text) > _MAX_SPAN_CHARS
585|        ):
586|            old_hash, old_text = corpus.pop(0)
587|            seen["span_chars"] = max(0, seen["span_chars"] - len(old_text))
588|            _drop_indexed_lines(seen, old_hash)
589|        corpus.append((key, text))
590|        seen["span_chars"] += len(text)
591|        for ln in text.split("\n"):
592|            _index_long_line(seen, ln, key)
593|        _index_json_inners(seen, text, key)
594|    return key

612|        with _SEEN_LOCK:

614|            turns = seen.get("turns", {})
615|            ids = list(turns.keys())
616|            if current_turn in ids:
617|                cutoff = ids.index(current_turn) - keep_turns
618|                old_ids = ids[: cutoff + 1] if cutoff >= 0 else []
619|            else:

621|            for tid in old_ids:
622|                bucket = turns.get(tid, {})
623|                if bucket.get("masked"):
624|                    continue
625|                for digest in bucket.get("hashes", []):

628|                        continue
629|                    out[digest] = mask_summary(original, digest, len(original))

636|def minify_json(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
637|    """Lossless JSON minify (whole-doc only, never partial). Returns (text, saved)."""
638|    try:
639|        import json as _json
640|
641|        stripped = text.strip()
642|        if not stripped or stripped[0] not in "{[":
643|            return text, 0
644|        try:
645|            data = fast_json_loads(stripped)
646|            tail = ""
647|        except Exception:
648|            try:
649|                data, idx = _json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(stripped)
650|            except Exception:
651|                return text, 0
652|            tail = stripped[idx:]
653|            if len(tail) > 4096 or not tail.strip():
654|                return text, 0
655|            if "{" in tail or "[" in tail:
656|                return text, 0
657|        mini = _json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False) + tail
658|        if len(mini) < len(text):
659|            return mini, len(text) - len(mini)
660|        return text, 0
661|    except Exception:
662|        return text, 0

695|    next read is a cold verbatim read.  That is a small token cost, never a

742|def _unwrap_numbered_lines(
743|    text: str,
744|) -> tuple[str, list[str] | None, list[int] | None, list[str], list[str]]:
745|    """Unwrap Hermes `LINE|CONTENT` output into (raw_body, prefixes, line_nos, headers, footers).
746|
747|    Hermes' read_file returns every line prefixed with its own line number
748|    ("42|    return total"). That prefix breaks ast.parse(), breaks the outline
749|    detector and makes every re-read look like a full-file change, so the 3-tier
750|    engine has to look at the raw source and re-attach the original numbers.
751|    Raw (unnumbered) payloads are returned untouched.
752|    """
753|    lines = text.split("\n")
754|    if len(lines) < 4:
755|        return text, None, None, [], []
756|    sample = [ln for ln in lines[:12] if ln.strip()]
757|    matches = sum(1 for ln in sample if _NUMBERED_LINE_RE.match(ln))
758|    if matches < max(2, len(sample) // 2):
759|        return text, None, None, [], []
760|    first_idx = -1
761|    last_idx = -1
762|    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
763|        if _NUMBERED_LINE_RE.match(ln):
764|            if first_idx == -1:
765|                first_idx = i
766|            last_idx = i
767|    if first_idx == -1 or last_idx - first_idx < 3:
768|        return text, None, None, [], []
769|    headers = lines[:first_idx]
770|    footers = lines[last_idx + 1:]
771|    prefixes: list[str] = []
772|    line_nos: list[int] = []
773|    raw_lines: list[str] = []
774|    for i in range(first_idx, last_idx + 1):
775|        m = _NUMBERED_LINE_RE.match(lines[i])
776|        if m:
777|            prefixes.append(m.group(1))
778|            line_nos.append(int(m.group(2)))
779|            raw_lines.append(m.group(3))
780|        else:
781|            prev_no = line_nos[-1] if line_nos else 1
782|            prefixes.append("")
783|            line_nos.append(prev_no)
784|            raw_lines.append(lines[i])
785|    return "\n".join(raw_lines), prefixes, line_nos, headers, footers

788|def _is_targeted_slice(
789|    offset: int | None,
790|    limit: int | None,
791|    first_line_no: int,
792|    n_lines: int,
793|) -> bool:
794|    """Is this a targeted line-range slice (must stay verbatim) or a full read?
795|
796|    Hermes always fills `offset=1, limit=2000` on a full read, so the mere
797|    presence of those args says nothing. A read is targeted only when it starts
798|    inside the file or when the caller deliberately capped a small window.
799|    """
800|    if offset is not None and offset > 1:
801|        return True
802|    if first_line_no > 1:
803|        return True
804|    if limit is not None and limit < _DEFAULT_LIMIT_FLOOR and n_lines >= limit:
805|        return True
806|    return False

809|def _build_file_outline(text: str, line_nos: list[int] | None = None, max_items: int = 35) -> str:
810|    """Fast O(N) structural outline (classes/functions with real file line numbers)."""
811|    items: list[str] = []
812|    raw_lines = text.split("\n")
813|    for idx, line in enumerate(raw_lines):
814|        ln_no = line_nos[idx] if (line_nos and idx < len(line_nos)) else (idx + 1)
815|        s = line.lstrip()
816|        if s.startswith(("def ", "async def ", "class ", "interface ", "func ", "fn ", "pub fn ", "export function ")):
817|            sig = s.split("{")[0].strip()
818|            if sig.endswith(":"):
819|                sig = sig[:-1].strip()
820|            items.append(f"  L{ln_no}: {sig[:90]}")
821|            if len(items) >= max_items:
822|                items.append("  ...")
823|                break
824|    return "\n".join(items) if items else f"  (total {len(raw_lines)} lines)"

827|def _build_read_delta(
828|    prev_text: str,
829|    cur_text: str,
830|    cur_ref: str,
831|    prev_ref: str,
832|    *,
833|    cur_prefixes: list[str] | None = None,
834|    cur_line_nos: list[int] | None = None,
835|    ctx_lines: int = _READ_DELTA_CONTEXT_LINES,
836|) -> tuple[str, int]:
837|    """Build a line-numbered contextual diff view of a modified file.
838|
839|    `prev_text` / `cur_text` are the UNPREFIXED sources; the original Hermes
840|    `LINE|` prefixes are re-attached to the emitted lines so the agent can still
841|    patch by real line number.
842|    """
843|    prev_lines = prev_text.split("\n")
844|    cur_lines = cur_text.split("\n")
845|    matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, prev_lines, cur_lines, autojunk=False)
846|    changed_cur_indices: list[int] = []
847|    for tag, _i1, _i2, j1, j2 in matcher.get_opcodes():
848|        if tag != "equal":
849|            changed_cur_indices.extend(range(j1, max(j1 + 1, j2)))
850|
851|    if not changed_cur_indices:
852|        return cur_text, 0
853|
854|    total = len(cur_lines)
855|    intervals: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
856|    for idx in changed_cur_indices:
857|        s = max(0, idx - ctx_lines)
858|        e = min(total, idx + ctx_lines + 1)
859|        if intervals and s <= intervals[-1][1]:
860|            intervals[-1] = (intervals[-1][0], max(intervals[-1][1], e))
861|        else:
862|            intervals.append((s, e))
863|
864|    chunks = [
865|        f"[tt:file_delta #{cur_ref} vs #{prev_ref} | {total}L total, showing modified hunks +/-{ctx_lines}L]"
866|    ]
867|    prev_end = 0
868|    for s, e in intervals:
869|        if s > prev_end:
870|            l_start = cur_line_nos[prev_end] if (cur_line_nos and prev_end < len(cur_line_nos)) else (prev_end + 1)
871|            l_end = cur_line_nos[s - 1] if (cur_line_nos and s - 1 < len(cur_line_nos)) else s
872|            chunks.append(f"[... L{l_start}-L{l_end} ({s - prev_end} unchanged lines in #{cur_ref}) ...]")
873|        for ln_idx in range(s, e):
874|            prefix = cur_prefixes[ln_idx] if (cur_prefixes and ln_idx < len(cur_prefixes)) else f"{ln_idx + 1}|"
875|            chunks.append(f"{prefix}{cur_lines[ln_idx]}")
876|        prev_end = e
877|    if prev_end < total:
878|        l_start = cur_line_nos[prev_end] if (cur_line_nos and prev_end < len(cur_line_nos)) else (prev_end + 1)
879|        l_end = cur_line_nos[total - 1] if (cur_line_nos and total - 1 < len(cur_line_nos)) else total
880|        chunks.append(f"[... L{l_start}-L{l_end} ({total - prev_end} unchanged lines in #{cur_ref}) ...]")
881|
882|    delta_str = "\n".join(chunks)
883|    orig_approx_len = len(cur_text) + (len(cur_lines) * 5 if cur_prefixes else 0)
884|    saved = orig_approx_len - len(delta_str)
885|    if saved <= 120:
886|        return cur_text, 0
887|    return delta_str, saved
888|

890|def _tok_pair(orig: str, cand: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
891|    """Token counts for the BPE non-inflation gate.
892|
893|    A real BPE pass costs ~0.5 ms per KB, which dominates a file read. When the
894|    candidate is clearly shorter (<90% of the original) the char ratio already
895|    proves the token count dropped, so the expensive pass is only used for the
896|    near-equal case where it actually matters.
897|    """
898|    if len(cand) < len(orig) * 0.9:
899|        return len(orig) // 4, len(cand) // 4
900|    return estimate_tokens(orig), estimate_tokens(cand)

903|def _handle_read_file_v42(
904|    result: str,
905|    session_id: str,
906|    args: Any,
907|    min_chars: int,
908|    t0: float,
909|    deadline: Any | None = None,
910|) -> tuple[str, dict]:
911|    """3-Tier Stateful Handler for read_file / read_file_extra with 100% Patch Safety.
912|
913|    Hermes hands us `LINE|CONTENT` payloads and always fills offset=1/limit=2000,
914|    so the payload is unwrapped to raw source first and the original line
915|    numbers are re-attached to whatever we emit.
916|    """
917|    norm_path, offset, limit = _extract_file_args(args)
918|    digest = hashlib.sha256(result.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:12]
919|    raw_body, prefixes, line_nos, headers, footers = _unwrap_numbered_lines(result)
920|    clean_text, _ = hygiene(raw_body)
921|    remember(clean_text, session_id, owner=digest)
922|
923|    first_line_no = line_nos[0] if line_nos else (offset if offset and offset > 0 else 1)
924|    n_lines = len(line_nos) if line_nos else (raw_body.count("\n") + 1)
925|
926|    # Rule 0: a targeted slice (or a small file) stays verbatim so that a
927|    # subsequent patch is never handed a mangled body.
928|    if len(result) < min_chars or _is_targeted_slice(offset, limit, first_line_no, n_lines):
929|        return result, {
930|            "gate": "passthrough_reference", "digest": digest,
931|            "reason": "small" if len(result) < min_chars else "targeted_slice",
932|            "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
933|        }
934|
935|    with _SEEN_LOCK:
936|        seen = _seen(session_id)
937|        file_cache: dict[str, dict] = seen.setdefault("files", {})
938|        cache_key = norm_path or f"__anon_{digest}"
939|        prev_entry = file_cache.get(cache_key)
940|
941|        # Case A: the same file is read again with identical content.
942|        if (
943|            prev_entry is not None
944|            and prev_entry.get("digest") == digest
945|            and not prev_entry.get("expired", False)
946|        ):
947|            # Anti-poisoning rail: if the agent already got a stub (or only a
948|            # skeleton) for this file, hand over the real body instead of
949|            # another pointer -- otherwise it loops on stubs.
950|            if prev_entry.get("skeleton_only") or prev_entry.get("stub_hits", 0) >= 1:
951|                prev_entry["skeleton_only"] = False
952|                prev_entry["stub_hits"] = 0
953|                return result, {
954|                    "gate": "passthrough_reference", "digest": digest,
955|                    "reason": "anti_poison",
956|                    "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
957|                }
958|            prev_entry["reads"] = prev_entry.get("reads", 1) + 1
959|            prev_entry["stub_hits"] = prev_entry.get("stub_hits", 0) + 1
960|            outline = _build_file_outline(raw_body, line_nos=line_nos)
961|            stub = (
962|                f"[tt:file_unchanged #{digest} path=\"{norm_path or 'file'}\" "
963|                f"({len(result)} chars, {n_lines}L) — identical to prior read in active context]\n"
964|                f"Outline (read_file offset/limit for exact lines):\n"
965|                f"{outline}"
966|            )
967|            tb, ta = _tok_pair(result, stub)
968|            if len(stub) < len(result) and ta < tb:
969|                return stub, {
970|                    "gate": "ok",
971|                    "kind": "file_cache_hit",
972|                    "digest": digest,
973|                    "before_chars": len(result),
974|                    "after_chars": len(stub),
975|                    "saved_chars": len(result) - len(stub),
976|                    "est_tokens_before": tb,
977|                    "est_tokens_after": ta,
978|                    "fold_saved": len(result) - len(stub),
979|                    "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
980|                }
981|
982|        # Case B: the file was modified since the last read -> contextual delta.
983|        if norm_path and prev_entry is not None and prev_entry.get("digest") != digest:
984|            prev_raw = prev_entry.get("raw_body") or ""
985|            prev_full = prev_entry.get("text", prev_raw)
986|            prev_digest = prev_entry.get("digest", "")
987|            # SequenceMatcher is O(n*m) on lines -- skip the delta for big files.
988|            if prev_raw and n_lines <= 1500:
989|                # The header advertises #prev_ref, so the previous body has to be
990|                # retrievable by that ref -> store it in the CCR now.
991|                prev_ref = prev_digest
992|                try:
993|                    stored = _ccr_put(prev_full)
994|                    if stored:
995|                        prev_ref = stored.lstrip("#")
996|                except Exception:
997|                    pass
998|                delta_view, _ = _build_read_delta(
999|                    prev_raw, raw_body, digest, prev_ref,
1000|                    cur_prefixes=prefixes, cur_line_nos=line_nos,
1001|                )
1002|                d_saved = len(result) - len(delta_view)
1003|                file_cache[cache_key] = {
1004|                    "digest": digest, "text": result, "raw_body": raw_body,
1005|                    "reads": 1, "stub_hits": 0, "expired": False, "skeleton_only": False,
1006|                }
1007|                if d_saved > 120:
1008|                    tb, ta = _tok_pair(result, delta_view)
1009|                    if ta < tb:
1010|                        return delta_view, {
1011|                            "gate": "ok",
1012|                            "kind": "file_delta",
1013|                            "digest": digest,
1014|                            "before_chars": len(result),
1015|                            "after_chars": len(delta_view),
1016|                            "saved_chars": d_saved,
1017|                            "est_tokens_before": tb,
1018|                            "est_tokens_after": ta,
1019|                            "fold_saved": d_saved,
1020|                            "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
1021|                        }
1022|
1023|        # Record the state of this read (first read or a read we did not fold).
1024|        if len(file_cache) >= _MAX_FILE_CACHE:
1025|            for _old_key in list(file_cache.keys())[: len(file_cache) - _MAX_FILE_CACHE + 1]:
1026|                file_cache.pop(_old_key, None)
1027|        file_cache[cache_key] = {
1028|            "digest": digest, "text": result, "raw_body": raw_body,
1029|            "reads": 1, "stub_hits": 0, "expired": False, "skeleton_only": False,
1030|        }
1031|
1032|        # Case C: cold first read of a large file -> line-anchored AST skeleton.
1033|        # Fail-open: if the guard budget is already gone, ship the verbatim file
1034|        # instead of blowing the deadline.
1035|        budget_left = True
1036|        if deadline is not None:
1037|            try:
1038|                deadline.check()
1039|            except Exception:
1040|                budget_left = False
1041|        if budget_left and (len(result) >= _COLD_READ_SKELETON_MIN_CHARS or len(raw_body) >= _COLD_READ_SKELETON_MIN_CHARS):
1042|            # The skeleton advertises retrieve(hash=#...), so the full body must be in
1043|            # the CCR before the marker ships -- otherwise the folded 60% of the file
1044|            # is unreachable (dead pointer). No store -> stay verbatim.
1045|            _sk_ref = _ccr_put(result)
1046|            if not _sk_ref:
1047|                return result, {
1048|                    "gate": "passthrough_reference", "digest": digest,
1049|                    "reason": "ccr_unavailable",
1050|                    "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
1051|                }
1052|            sk_body, sk_saved, fn_count = smart_skeletonize_code(
1053|                raw_body, ref=f"#{_sk_ref.lstrip('#')}", line_prefixes=prefixes, line_nos=line_nos,
1054|            )
1055|            if sk_saved > 200 and fn_count > 0:
1056|                rebuilt = "\n".join(headers + [sk_body] + footers) if (headers or footers) else sk_body
1057|                actual_saved = len(result) - len(rebuilt)
1058|                head = adaptive_tool_head(max(actual_saved, sk_saved), digest, len(result))
1059|                candidate = f"{head}\n{rebuilt}" if head else rebuilt
1060|                tb, ta = _tok_pair(result, candidate)
1061|                if len(candidate) < len(result) and ta < tb:
1062|                    file_cache[cache_key]["skeleton_only"] = True
1063|                    return candidate, {
1064|                        "gate": "ok",
1065|                        "kind": "file_skeleton",
1066|                        "digest": digest,
1067|                        "before_chars": len(result),
1068|                        "after_chars": len(candidate),
1069|                        "saved_chars": len(result) - len(candidate),
1070|                        "est_tokens_before": tb,
1071|                        "est_tokens_after": ta,
1072|                        "skeleton_saved": len(result) - len(candidate),
1073|                        "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
1074|                    }
1075|
1076|    # Cold first read of a file under _COLD_READ_SKELETON_MIN_CHARS: verbatim so
1077|    # the agent can patch safely.
1078|    return result, {
1079|        "gate": "passthrough_reference", "digest": digest,
1080|        "reason": "below_skeleton_min",
1081|        "ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
1082|    }

1085|def micro_minify_tool(result: str, session_id: str, t0: float) -> tuple[str, dict]:
1086|    """Zero-risk fast lane for 512..2047 char tool outputs (Tier 0 headerless).
1087|
1088|    Deliberately avoids estimate_tokens(): that is a real BPE pass (~0.19 ms per
1089|    1.6 KB) and this lane's whole point is to be near-free on every tool result
1090|    (plan target p95 < 0.25 ms). hygiene/minify_json only remove characters, so a
1091|    char-based estimate is both safe and honest here.
1092|    """
1093|    digest = hashlib.sha256(result.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:12]
1094|    # A unified diff carries " " on its blank context lines -- hygiene would strip
1095|    # that space and corrupt the diff.
1096|    if "diff --git" in result[:512] or "\n@@ -" in result[:512]:
1097|        text, h_saved = result, 0
1098|    else:
1099|        text, h_saved = hygiene(result)
1100|    text, m_saved = minify_json(text)
1101|    total_saved = len(result) - len(text)
1102|    if total_saved >= 4 and len(text) < len(result):
1103|        remember(text, session_id, owner=digest)
1104|        return text, {
